text_block_list.text: One day, in the trainer's office...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
It's almost time for training. I can handle
whatever
you've got planned for me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Knock, knock!
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, do you have some time to
spare?
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава
choice_data_list: What can we do for you, Tazuna?

text_block_list.text: Hehe, I've actually got some big news!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
It appears your efforts have been very
well
received by the URA staff. So...
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
They would like to invite you to a dinner
party!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text: Wow, that's amazing!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Of course, this is all thanks to my
excellence! Do
feel free to express your
gratitude!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Plus, it seems like it will be a black-tie
event at a
five-star hotel.
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
With the strict codes concerning attire
and table
manners, this should be quite
the experience!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text:
At any rate, congratulations on being
invited to
such a fabulous party!
text_block_list.name: Тазуна Хаякава

text_block_list.text: Hmm, a dinner party at a five-star hotel.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm sure the food will be first-rate too! I
wonder
what the menu will look like...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: What's got you so flustered?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I explain that I don't have the table
manners or
etiquette to make it through
a fancy dinner party.
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text: Ahhh, so that's the problem.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: In that case, come with me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Knives, forks, formal plates... Everything
looks to
be in order.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Now then. First, place the napkin on
your lap.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I'm trying to teach you table manners,
that's what.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: You're worried about the dinner party, aren't you? This time, I shall train you!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Surely I've mentioned this before, but
I'm
first-rate at everything I do!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
So, if you're ready to begin, it's time for
a crash
course in manners!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
That's it. And once you've finished
eating, just
place your knife and fork
like so...
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Very good. I suppose you've mastered
the basics
of etiquette, at least.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Oh, this is nothing for me.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
After all, it's only natural that someone
as
first-rate as I am would know basic
etiquette!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: I would expect nothing less, my lady.

Huh, you really are first-rate at everything you
do.

text_block_list.text:
After all, it's only natural that someone
as
first-rate as I am would know basic
etiquette!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало
choice_data_list: I would expect nothing less, my lady.

Huh, you really are first-rate at everything you
do.

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho! Now you must become a first-rate trainer worthy of me!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
I will graciously accept cake as a token
of your
gratitude!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
A ruffled cake that delights both the
eyes and
taste buds shall do nicely!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Along with an orange pekoe black tea,
of course.
I won't accept anything less.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text: Ohohoho!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Well, I've been eating at upscale places
ever
since I was little.
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
...Wait a minute! What do you mean,
"really"?!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Did you not honestly believe that I
would be
first-rate?
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
Sit yourself down one more time! I'll
show you
what first-rate truly means!
text_block_list.name: Кинг Хало

text_block_list.text:
And just like that, the advanced course
on table
manners begins...
text_block_list.name: Монолог

text_block_list.text:
Кинг Хало might have enjoyed that "my
lady" quip
a bit too much...
text_block_list.name: Монолог
